searchText: can a smart contract support asymmetric key exchanges? i.e. implement a handshake at the start of any sequence, to enable privacy? or is that an unfeasonably expensive amount of computation or something? https://blog.nucypher.com/bringing-privacy-to-smart-contracts-is-nontrivial/ looks like a good writeup In general it isn't simple for a smart contract to "keep secrets". because any private keys it would generate would be visible to all? Yes, anything that a smart contract does is "visible" and thus, the only way that I'm aware for them to have a secret is using "math magic" (snarky stuff, homomorphic encryption, etc), which are all complex topics. but perhaps not an intractable problem, if such complex solutions work i guess i've got some reading to do on math magic. thanks
